Maccy — https://github.com/p0deje/Maccy
Reference revision: f0b571e32e4031d7b91ba811f50d0f33e8e5548b

Friday's clipboard module adapts Maccy's pasteboard type filtering and
multi-representation clipboard replay approach. Friday-specific storage,
lifecycle, settings and UI are implemented separately.
